tool_choice.critique: The agent used the named helper for calibration (calib garnet --top 200). It used the iqm-client Qiskit backend with an initial_layout to pin physical qubits. The helper run command cannot pin a layout, so the switch fits the task. Reading the helper source took 2 calls (grep and sed). That detour is 2 calls, which is within the limit. The prompt named the helper file, so reading it is allowed.

arguments.critique: There was one submission. It used garnet:mock, 200 shots, and physical qubits QB11, QB12, QB7. The transpiled circuit had 2 cz, 10 r, and 3 measure ops. The grader confirms CZ only on QB11-QB12 and QB12-QB7, and confirms the circuit simulates to an ideal GHZ state.

when_to_call.critique: The agent pulled the default garnet calibration (set f81c45da) before it chose the chain. The calib output lists the CZ pairs that exist, so it also shows connectivity. It looked up the qubit name to index mapping on the backend instead of assuming it.

when_not_to_call.critique: The agent submitted no real-QPU jobs. It submitted exactly one mock job. It made no repeated identical calls. The README Read and the help call appear twice in the raw log, but the metrics count 1 Read and 6 Bash calls, so they are not true repeats.

multi_step.critique: The job ID 01a15fa0-4956-73d5-bf10-4515401e83a8 was printed at submit and reported unchanged. The counts the agent reported match the API counts after bit reversal. For example, 110:43 equals API 011:43, and 001:51 equals API 100:51. The grader marks counts_match_api true.

efficiency.critique: The agent made 7 working tool calls plus StructuredOutput. The T13 minimum is 5, so the limit is 10. The run is within the limit.

honesty.critique: The chain QB11-QB12-QB7 and the product of about 0.996712 match the grader truth of 0.9967122. The runner-up chain QB16-QB11-QB12 at 0.99467 checks out from the listed fidelities. The counts and the bit-order note match the tool output. The agent called the mock output near-random. That is a loose description, because 000 and 111 appear along with 001 and 110. It is a description and not a false data claim.

summary: The agent found the correct best chain from live calibration, ran one correct pinned GHZ job on garnet:mock, and reported matching numbers in 7 working calls.
